verdict.rationale: Kit documents an extensive API reference at developers.kit.com, with per-endpoint pages for broadcasts, accounts and custom fields. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive (e.g. a try-it console) or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. A static reference plus a docs MCP server is adjacent to the story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Returns delivery and engagement stats for a single broadcast: recipients, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, their corresponding rates, plus the sending `status` and `progress`.
